# Advisors Group International Inc

> Small-business accounting, tax advisory and preparation, business advisory, and notary services in Montgomery, Texas.

Advisors Group International Inc is a Montgomery, Texas advisory firm serving small businesses and their owners.

## Services

Business advisory: practical guidance on structure, planning, and operations for owner-operated businesses.

Tax advisory: year-round tax strategy — not just a conversation in April.

Tax preparation: individual and small-business return preparation, done carefully and filed on time. Small-business tax preparation includes local, state and federal filings, for all US states, for businesses and their owners in Montgomery, The Woodlands and Conroe. Also: individual tax preparation for business owners; non-profit tax preparation; bookkeeping and accounting support in QuickBooks Online, Xero, NetSuite and Patriot Software; notary public services.

Accounting: clean books, clear reports, and accounting support built around QuickBooks Online.

Notary services: Texas notary public services available by appointment.
